description:
Gnosis Chain on-chain read: a contract's event logs, filtered by topic and block range. Returns raw event logs for one Gnosis contract via eth_getLogs. Takes address (0x+40 hex), optional topic0 (0x+64 hex), optional blocks (last N, default 10).

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/gnosis_eth_getlogs. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
